content.rendered:
Model Policy

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF

Section 1. {Title}

This Act may be cited as the Synthetic Lantern Registry Act.

Section 2. {Definitions}

(A) “Lantern” means a portable lamp kept under [reference any state lamp code].

(B) “Registry” means the list kept by the [secretary of state].

Drafting Note: A state may rename the registry.

Section 3. {Registration}

A keeper shall register each lantern within [60] days with {insert name of office}.

A fee of ten twelve dollars applies. {Drafting note: a state may waive it.}

Approved by ALEC Board of Directors in 1995.

Reapproved by ALEC Board of Directors on September 18, 2018.

Model Resolution

WHEREAS, invented lamps light invented streets; and

WHEREAS, the keepers of invented lamps ask for a week of their own;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the legislature of the State of [state] supports an invented Lamp Week.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that a copy of this resolution be sent to [insert recipients].
